newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gilts prices up on easier call money.
newsitem.headline: Indian gilts prices up on easier call money.

text.p: * Indian government security prices up in moderate Wednesday noon trade on improved sentiment as call money eases, dealers said.
* Call money drops to 7.5-8.5 percent from opening quotes of 8.0-9.0 and Monday's 10.50.

* Dealers said prices expected to remain firm as liquidity is seen good. Reserve Bank of India dollar purchases from Monday seen pumping rupees into domestic money market and depressing call money rates.

* In latest deals, the 13.85 percent 2001 government of India stock traded at 104.50 rupees against last traded 104.15, 13.50 percent 1997 at 101.65 against 101.50, 13.50 percent 1998 at 102.70 against 102.45 and 13.85 percent 2000 at 105.25 against 104.25, dealers said.
* Trades also reported in 14 percent 2006 at 106.35 rupees.
